title: Public Health Analytics-OS relationship vocabulary
directionRule: Every relationship is read from source to target. An inverse must be explicitly defined; consumers must not reverse an edge by assumption.
aggregationRule: No relationship authorizes numerical aggregation unless aggregationSafe is explicitly true and the cited evidence supports compatible populations, periods, definitions and units.

predicates.meaning: The source document defines or enumerates the source object.
The organization publishes or maintains the source document.
The source object is governed, used or scoped within the programme.
requiredEvidence: programme source or documented analytical rationale

predicates.meaning: The manifestation is assigned to a normalized programme component.
requiredEvidence: preserved source label or documented normalization

predicates.meaning: Analytics-OS maps the manifestation to a WHO health-system building block.
predicates.doesNotMean: Source-custodian classification unless assertionStatus is official.

predicates.meaning: The normalized lowest level at which the manifestation is reported or generated.
requiredEvidence: source level label retained in provenance

predicates.meaning: The manifestation has a normalized measurement class.
requiredEvidence: formula, unit, scale or source method

predicates.meaning: The source object is represented or reported through the named information system.
The source-specific manifestation maps directionally to an analytical concept.
The source measure uses the target HMIS data element as an input.
requiredEvidence: formula, form, dictionary or documented crosswalk

predicates.meaning: The records are useful to navigate together but no equivalence or computability is asserted.
A typed HMIS association whose operational semantics remain source-governed.
requiredEvidence: relationship type, direction and crosswalk status

predicates.meaning: The evidence gap limits the declared completeness of the programme release.

mappingRelations.meaning: Equivalent construct and operational semantics within the declared versions and context.
mappingRelations.aggregationPermission: Not automatic; aggregationSafe and compatibility evidence are still required.

mappingRelations.meaning: Conceptually close, but at least one operational detail prevents exact equivalence.
The target concept is broader than the source manifestation.
The target concept is narrower than the source manifestation.
Useful association without equivalence or hierarchy.

assertionStatuses.meaning: Explicitly asserted by the cited source.
Reviewed analytical assertion made by Analytics-OS.
Deterministic mapping from a preserved source label to a controlled term.
Provisional assertion requiring domain or custodian review.
